title: Verb taxonomy: ceremony-class map (contract.md §3, design §4.2)
description: Machine-checkable map of EVERY contract verb to its ceremony class (read / low-stakes / irreversible) plus family and evt/req kind. Invariant 4 requires EVERY irreversible verb to run the full §6 ceremony. This file is the single source of truth a later phase's dispatcher loads to know which verbs must escalate.

classes.description: 'none' = an evt/handshake sub-verb that carries no independent ceremony.

interlock.description: extra IBAN-style interlock this verb enforces (§3.11 / §2.4).

gated.description: owner-open gate: DISABLED/fail-closed until an §11 question is answered.
